ask: I have just had a big tax bill, so £2,600 is the most I can do. I would love to give it a good home. Shall we say yes?

Best wishes

ask: With the new features and our own cost rises, the renewal comes to £32,500 a year. Shall I send the order form?
text:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for sending this through. Please hold off on the order form for now.

£32,500 is a 35% increase on the £24,000 we pay today, with our user count unchanged at 85. That's well beyond what I can get signed off, and it's hard to justify internally on the basis of features we haven't asked for.

The contract runs to 30 June, so we have time to get this right. Let me know what you can do.

Thanks
